_comment: S81 page-range pre-filter map. Ranges verified against the Cheiro page-level export (cheiroslanguageo00chei_1); the six known target chunks (p165_c2/p163_c1 fate, p145_c0 head, p160_c3/p159_c2/p160_c1 heart) all reconcile against these ranges. Keys are the EXACT palm_reading._FEATURE_REGISTRY strings, not the chapter titles supplied in the instructing prompt. Consumed by agent/interpretive/palm_reading.py's _load_feature_page_ranges(); a null start/end means no verified chapter mapping exists for that registry key -- see its own 'reason' field. Do not guess a range for a null entry without new verified evidence. Thumb was narrowed 94->92 and fingers widened 95->93 to align with the CHAPTER IX (p85, THE THUMB), X (p93, THE JOINTS OF THE FINGERS), and XI (p95, THE FINGERS) boundaries, superseding the earlier 85-94/95-97 split.

head line.source_chapter: LINE OF HEAD (spans chapters VII, VIII, IX -- all head-line doctrine)

mount of venus.source_chapter: THE MOUNTS (no Venus-specific sub-range provided; the mounts chapter is a single 111-113 block covering all mounts)

mount of jupiter.source_chapter: THE MOUNTS (no Jupiter-specific sub-range provided; same 111-113 block as mount of venus)

markings/other features.reason: No chapter in the S81 instructing prompt's range map corresponds to marks/crosses/stars/signs doctrine. 'GENERAL LINES' (120-132) is a distinct classical category (minor lines: Via Lascivia, girdle of Venus context, travel/influence lines etc.), not signs-and-marks doctrine -- mapping 'markings/other features' onto it would be a guess, not a verified range, and the instructing prompt explicitly says not to guess. Falls through to unfiltered retrieval at runtime (see palm_reading._search_with_page_filter).
